title: GCN250 Curve Number — Assam Revenue Circles
description: Mean gridded curve number (a rainfall-runoff potential parameter) per Revenue Circle in Assam, sourced from the GCN250 global 250m curve number product, used as a hazard-conditioning covariate in the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk model.
purpose: Runoff-potential covariate for the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk score model.
details: RDLS's hazard object models hazard footprints/intensity directly; curve number is a hazard-conditioning covariate (runoff potential) rather than a hazard intensity measurement itself, so 'intensity_measure' here is used loosely to fit this covariate into the schema. License recorded as 'MIT' per the risk model's data dictionary — an unusual choice for a geospatial dataset (MIT is a software license), but that is what is declared there; worth double-checking with the team rather than assuming it is a data-licensing error.

gazetteer_entries.description: Assam Revenue Circles administrative boundaries (the object_id used across IDS-DRR variables) — a custom scheme, not yet a registered RDLS gazetteer.
